Issue #71 (PRC-501) is fixed and merged into `main` locally. `scripts/verify.sh` passes on the merged `main`. I haven't pushed: the repo has no remote configured. I also didn't comment on or close the issue.

I did not check whether any invoices or statements were already issued with the rounded-up amounts, since that data isn't in this repo. If any were, someone should decide whether to correct them.
